name: The Legend of Korrak
label: Quest
description: The Legend of Korrak: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power.
They are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast.
A strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. Slay the beast and be rewarded!
